source: b8-glm batch L3 klarna-r2 (rerun, decision 340), provider-calls.jsonl, reply content only; trimmed to RESP-1 and RESP-2 and their Call 2b records

responsibilities.description: Answer customer questions about Klarna policies, fees, payments, and eligibility by retrieving approved policy snippets and composing replies grounded only in published policy documents and the approved information whitelist.

responsibility_constraints.description: Ground policy answers only in approved policy snippets from retrieve_policy; never answer from the model's own knowledge or unpublished sources.
Do not provide details that are not on the approved information whitelist.
When a customer asks about fees, payments, or eligibility and retrieve_policy returns no matching approved policy snippet, do not answer from own knowledge and escalate to a human agent instead.

process_model_parts.description: Whether the customer's policy question topic is covered by an approved policy snippet
The customer's question topic category (fees, payments, eligibility, refunds, or other)
Whether the content of a drafted reply is supported by an approved source
values: supported by approved policy snippet or order record
not covered by any approved source

responsibilities.description: Look up and describe the authenticated customer's account details, orders, and payment status, stating only details present on the retrieved records.

responsibility_constraints.description: When describing a customer's order in a reply or tool arguments, state only the merchant, item, price, and purchase-date values present on the record returned by lookup_order, and never state any detail the retrieved record does not support.

process_model_parts.description: Which customer is authenticated in the current session
The retrieved order record's owner, item, merchant, price, and status
Whether the record requested by the customer belongs to the authenticated customer
